services.name: Lawn renovation and overseeding
services.blurb: Core aeration, compost topdressing and fescue seed in the fall window, so thin lawns fill back in.

services.name: Soil testing and amending
services.blurb: We sample your yard, read the pH, then loosen and feed the red clay before anything gets planted.

services.name: Planting beds and garden design
services.blurb: A drawn plan with every plant named, sized for the spot and chosen to handle Piedmont summers.

services.name: Sod installation
services.blurb: Graded, amended ground first, then tight seams and a written watering schedule for the first month.

services.name: Yard drainage fixes
services.blurb: Regrading, swales and French drains that move water away from the house instead of into the crawlspace.

services.name: Mulch and edging
services.blurb: Clean spade-cut edges and mulch at the right depth, kept off trunks and away from the siding.

services.name: Shrub and small tree care
services.blurb: Pruning at the right month for each plant, so azaleas still bloom and crape myrtles keep their shape.

services.name: Patios and walkways
services.blurb: Paver and flagstone set on a compacted stone base that will not heave after a wet winter.

services.name: Seasonal cleanup
services.blurb: Leaves hauled, beds cut back and gutters of debris cleared from the yard, spring and fall.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Two other companies wanted to lay sod straight over our clay. Marcus dug a hole, showed us the orange layer six inches down and explained why the last lawn died. We did the soil work first. A year later the fescue is thick right up to the driveway.
reviews.name: Renee K.

reviews.text: Our backyard held water for days after every storm. They regraded along the fence and ran a drain out to the street side. First big rain in May, no puddle.
reviews.name: Darnell P.

reviews.text: I liked getting the planting plan on paper with every plant labelled. I could look up each one before saying yes. The bed by the porch looks full after one season, and they told me exactly how often to water those first three weeks.
reviews.name: Hannah S.

reviews.text: Fall aeration and seed, done in late September like they said. They texted the day before, left the cores on the lawn on purpose and explained why. Grass came in by mid-October.
reviews.name: Jorge A.

reviews.text: Small job, a mulch refresh and edges around four beds, and they still showed up when they said. The edges are a real spade cut, not a string trimmer line. Mulch is kept off the tree trunks too.
reviews.name: Patrice W.

reviews.text: We wanted a flagstone path from the deck to the garden shed. They dug the base deeper than I expected and tamped every layer. Two winters in, not one stone has rocked.
reviews.name: Colin B.

proof.guarantee: Plants we install that fail in the first year with normal care are replaced once at no charge.
